title: Handley Page Halifax LK839
location_name: Foston on the Wolds, East Yorkshire
cause_of_loss: Crashed near Lissett on return from Kiel; all crew killed
memorial_details: Plain, rectangular brass plaque mounted on a wooden backboard. Dedication is incised in black, capital script.
inscription: IN LOVING MEMORY/ F/O Walter Bigelow Tower Rosen/ Sgt George William Blanckley/ [and five comrades]/ 158 SQUADRON RAF/ WHO PERISHED HERE/ 17TH AUGUST 1944

sources.title: Facebook post by Tony Hibberd (admin, RAF Bomber Command Memorials group), citing Chorley BCL Vol 5

narrative: On the night of 16/17 August 1944, Halifax LK839 (NP-S) of 158 Squadron was returning from a bombing raid on Kiel when it crashed near Lissett, East Yorkshire. All seven crew were killed. The memorial plaque is mounted above the doors of Foston-on-the-Wolds village hall.
custodian: Foston on the Wolds Village Hall
community_connection: The memorial plaque is mounted above the doors of Foston-on-the-Wolds village hall and is maintained by the village hall. Its prominent placement over the main entrance reflects the community's enduring connection to this loss.
